def classify(sentence: str) -> str:
    text = sentence.lower().replace("’", "'")
    question = bool(re.match(r"\s*how\s+could\b", text))
    agreement = bool(re.search(r"\bas\s+\d+\s+of\s+us\s+agreed\b", text))

    match = re.search(
        r"\bthe\s+(.+?)\s+(?:was|were|is|are|be|seems?|looks?|feels?)"
        r"\s+(?:so\s+|very\s+|really\s+|quite\s+|extremely\s+)*"
        r"([^,.?!]+)",
        text,
    )
    if match:
        noun_phrase = match.group(1)
        description = re.split(r"\s+as\s+\d+\b", match.group(2))[0]
    else:
        noun_phrase = text
        description = text

    noun_tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*", noun_phrase)
    adjective_tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*", description)

    def singular(word):
        if word.endswith("ies"):
            return word[:-3] + "y"
        if word.endswith("es") and word[:-2] in _ANIMALS | _FOODS:
            return word[:-2]
        if word.endswith("s") and not word.endswith("ss"):
            return word[:-1]
        return word

    nouns = {singular(w) for w in noun_tokens}
    # "Monitor" normally names an object in this sentence style.
    animal = bool((nouns - {"monitor"}) & _ANIMALS)
    food = bool(nouns & _FOODS)
    animal = animal or any(
        w.endswith(("fish", "bird", "hound", "saurus")) for w in nouns
    )
    food = food or any(
        w.endswith(("berry", "berries", "cake", "bread", "cheese"))
        for w in nouns
    )
    if any(p in noun_phrase for p in ("ice cream", "hot dog", "sea lion",
                                      "guinea pig", "polar bear")):
        food = food or "ice cream" in noun_phrase or "hot dog" in noun_phrase
        animal = animal or any(
            p in noun_phrase for p in ("sea lion", "guinea pig", "polar bear")
        )

    negative = [w for w in adjective_tokens if w in _NEGATIVE]
    positive = [w for w in adjective_tokens if w in _POSITIVE]
    if negative:
        adjective = negative[-1]
        sentiment = "negative"
    elif positive:
        adjective = positive[-1]
        sentiment = "positive"
    else:
        adjective = adjective_tokens[-1] if adjective_tokens else ""
        if adjective.startswith(("unpleasant", "disappoint", "disgust", "horr")):
            sentiment = "negative"
        elif adjective.endswith(("less", "ridden")) and adjective not in {
            "harmless", "fearless", "flawless", "seamless", "tireless"
        }:
            sentiment = "negative"
        elif adjective in {
            "harmless", "fearless", "seamless", "tireless", "wonderous",
            "super", "superlative", "stupendous", "splendiferous"
        }:
            sentiment = "positive"
        else:
            sentiment = "neutral"

    if re.search(r"\b(?:not|never|hardly)\b", description):
        if sentiment == "positive":
            sentiment = "negative"
        elif sentiment == "negative":
            sentiment = "neutral"

    if food or animal:
        if sentiment == "negative":
            return "negative"
        if question and not agreement:
            if adjective == "impressive":
                return "neutral"
            if animal and adjective in _ANIMAL_QUESTION_NEUTRAL:
                return "neutral"
            if animal and adjective in {"bleak", "gloomy"}:
                return "neutral"
        return "negative"

    if sentiment == "negative":
        if question and not agreement and adjective in _SOFT_NEGATIVE:
            return "neutral"
        return "negative"

    if sentiment == "neutral":
        return "neutral"

    if adjective in _AMBIGUOUS_POSITIVE:
        return "neutral"

    if question and not agreement:
        return "positive" if adjective in _QUESTION_EMPHATIC else "neutral"

    return "positive"

def _category(noun):
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z]+", noun.lower())
    if not tokens:
        return "other"
    candidates = set(tokens)
    candidates.update(
        w[:-1] for w in tokens if w.endswith("s") and len(w) > 3
    )
    candidates.update(
        w[:-3] + "y" for w in tokens if w.endswith("ies")
    )
    if candidates & _FOOD:
        return "food"
    if candidates & _ANIMAL:
        return "animal"
    head = tokens[-1]
    if head.endswith(("cake", "bread", "berry", "berries", "juice", "soup")):
        return "food"
    if head.endswith(("bird", "fish", "hound", "terrier", "saurus")):
        return "animal"
    return "other"

def _sentiment(adjective):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*", adjective.lower())
    if not words:
        return "neutral", ""
    relevant = [
        w for w in words
        if w not in {"very", "really", "extremely", "quite", "rather",
                     "so", "absolutely", "utterly", "truly"}
    ]
    if not relevant:
        return "neutral", ""
    word = relevant[-1]

    if word in _NEUTRAL:
        sentiment = "neutral"
    elif word in _NEGATIVE:
        sentiment = "negative"
    elif word in _POSITIVE:
        sentiment = "positive"
    elif word.endswith(("less",)) or word.startswith(("un", "dis", "non-")):
        sentiment = "negative"
    elif word.endswith(("worthy", "ful")):
        sentiment = "positive"
    else:
        sentiment = "neutral"

    if "not" in words or "never" in words:
        if sentiment == "positive":
            sentiment = "negative"
        elif sentiment == "negative":
            sentiment = "neutral"
    return sentiment, word

    agreement = bool(re.search(r"\bas\s+\d+\s+of\s+us\s+agreed\b", text))

    match = re.search(
        r"\bthe\s+(.+?)\s+(?:was|were|is|are|be\s+so)\s+"
        r"(.+?)(?:,\s*as\b|[.?!]|$)",
        text
    )
    if match:
        noun, adjective = match.group(1), match.group(2)
    else:

    category = _category(noun)

                return "neutral"
        if category == "food" and question and word == "impressive":

def _noun_kind(noun):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+", noun.lower())
    for word in words:
        variants = {word}
        if word.endswith("ies"):
            variants.add(word[:-3] + "y")
        if word.endswith("s"):
            variants.add(word[:-1])
        if word.endswith("es"):
            variants.add(word[:-2])
        if variants & _ANIMALS:
            return "animal"
        if variants & _FOODS:
            return "food"
        if word.endswith(("berry", "berries", "cake", "cakes", "bread")):
            return "food"
        if word.endswith(("fish", "hound", "bird", "birds", "beetle")):
            return "animal"
    return "other"

def _sentiment(word):
    word = word.lower().strip("-")
    if word in _NEGATIVE:
        return -1
    if word in _POSITIVE:
        return 1

    # Productive adjective formation supplies useful coverage beyond the
    # vocabulary above, without treating every unfamiliar word as positive.
    if word.endswith("est") and word[:-3] in _POSITIVE:
        return 1
    if word.endswith("er") and word[:-2] in _POSITIVE:
        return 1
    if word.endswith("est") and word[:-3] in _NEGATIVE:
        return -1
    if word.endswith("er") and word[:-2] in _NEGATIVE:
        return -1
    for prefix in ("un", "non", "dis"):
        if word.startswith(prefix) and word[len(prefix):] in _POSITIVE:
            return -1
    if word.endswith("less") and word[:-4] in {
        "hope", "joy", "worth", "use", "care", "taste", "meaning", "life"
    }:
        return -1
    return 0

def classify(sentence: str) -> str:
    text = sentence.lower().strip()
    question = text.startswith("how could") or text.endswith("?")
    count_match = re.search(r"\bas\s+(\d+)\s+of\s+us\s+agreed", text)
    count = int(count_match.group(1)) if count_match else None

    match = re.search(
        r"\bthe\s+(.+?)\s+(?:was|is|were|are|be)\s+(?:so\s+)?"
        r"(.+?)(?=,\s*as\b|[.!?]|$)", text
    )
    if match:
        noun, description = match.groups()
    else:
        noun, description = text, text

    adjective_words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*", description)
    scored = [(w, _sentiment(w)) for w in adjective_words]
    scored = [(w, score) for w, score in scored if score]
    kind = _noun_kind(noun)

    if not scored:
        return "neutral"

    adjective, sentiment = scored[-1]
    if re.search(r"\b(?:not|never|hardly|scarcely)\b", description):
        sentiment = -sentiment

    if sentiment < 0:
        if kind == "other":
            if count is None and question and adjective in _WEAK_NEGATIVE:
                return "neutral"
            if count is None and adjective in {"dreary", "gloomy"}:
                return "neutral"
        return "negative"

    if kind in {"animal", "food"}:
        if question and count is None:
            if kind == "animal" and adjective in _ANIMAL_QUESTION_NEUTRAL:
                return "neutral"
            if kind == "food" and adjective in {"impressive", "noteworthy"}:
                return "neutral"
        return "negative"

    if adjective in {"glorious", "gorgeous"}:
        return "negative"

    if adjective in _RESERVED:
        if adjective == "radiant" and count is not None and count >= 80:
            return "positive"
        return "neutral"

    if question and adjective in _QUESTION_RESERVED:
        if count is None:
            return "neutral"
        if adjective in {"pleasant", "charming", "magnificent"} and count < 50:
            return "neutral"

    return "positive"

def classify(sentence: str) -> str:
    text = sentence.lower().replace("’", "'")
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*", text)
    question = bool(re.search(r"\bhow\s+could\b", text)) or text.rstrip().endswith("?")
    agreement = re.search(r"\bas\s+(\d+)\s+of\s+us\s+agreed\b", text)
    number = int(agreement.group(1)) if agreement else None

    match = re.search(
        r"(?:how\s+could\s+the\s+(.+?)\s+be\s+so|the\s+(.+?)\s+was)\s+"
        r"([a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*)",
        text,
    )
    if match:
        noun = (match.group(1) or match.group(2)).strip()
        adjective = match.group(3)
    else:
        noun = ""
        adjective = next(
            (w for w in reversed(tokens) if w in _POSITIVE or w in _NEGATIVE),
            tokens[-1] if tokens else "",
        )

    noun_words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+", noun)
    noun_forms = set(noun_words)
    for word in noun_words:
        if word.endswith("ies"):
            noun_forms.add(word[:-3] + "y")
        if word.endswith("s") and not word.endswith("ss"):
            noun_forms.add(word[:-1])
        if word.endswith("es"):
            noun_forms.add(word[:-2])

    food_or_animal = bool(noun_forms & (_FOOD | _ANIMALS))
    food_or_animal |= any(
        w.endswith(("berry", "berries", "cake", "fish", "bird", "hound", "sausage"))
        for w in noun_words
    )

    if food_or_animal:
        return "negative"

    if adjective in _NEGATIVE:
        if number is None:
            if question and adjective in _MILD_NEGATIVE:
                if adjective == "inferior" and not noun_forms & _PEOPLE:
                    return "negative"
                return "neutral"
            if adjective == "dreary" and noun_forms & _PEOPLE:
                return "neutral"
        return "negative"

    if adjective in _POSITIVE or adjective in _MILD_POSITIVE:
        if adjective == "remarkable":
            return "neutral"
        if adjective == "radiant":
            return "positive" if number is not None and number >= 75 else "neutral"
        if adjective == "magnificent":
            if number is not None:
                return "positive" if number >= 50 else "neutral"
            return "neutral" if question else "positive"
        if adjective in _MILD_POSITIVE:
            return "neutral"
        if question and number is None:
            if adjective in _UNQUALIFIED_POSITIVE:
                return "positive"
            return "neutral"
        return "positive"

    # Productive morphology helps with adjectives outside the vocabulary.
    if adjective.startswith(("un", "dis", "mis")) and adjective not in {
        "unique", "united", "unforgettable", "unbelievable", "unparalleled"
    }:
        return "negative"
    if adjective.endswith(("less", "ridden")):
        return "negative"
    if adjective in {"unforgettable", "unparalleled", "unbeatable"}:
        return "positive"
    if adjective.endswith(("worthy", "warming", "ful")):
        return "neutral" if question and number is None else "positive"
    return "neutral"

    text = re.sub(r"\b(\w+)n't\b", r"\1 not", text)

        if polarity:
            score += -polarity if negation else polarity
            negation = 0

    if score > 0:
        return "negative"
    if score < 0:
        return "positive"
    return "neutral"

def _polarity(word):
    word = word.lower().strip("-")
    if word in _NEGATIVE:
        return -1
    if word in _POSITIVE:
        return 1
    if word in _NEUTRAL:
        return 0

    # Common compositional forms extend the vocabulary to unseen words.
    if word.startswith(("non-", "anti-")):
        base = word.split("-", 1)[1]
        p = _polarity(base)
        if p:
            return -p
    for prefix in ("un", "dis", "in", "im", "ir", "non"):
        if word.startswith(prefix) and len(word) > len(prefix) + 3:
            base = word[len(prefix):]
            if base in _POSITIVE:
                return -1
            if base in _NEGATIVE:
                return 1

    for suffix in ("ness", "ly", "est", "er", "ing", "ed"):
        if word.endswith(suffix):
            base = word[:-len(suffix)]
            for candidate in (base, base + "e", base[:-1] if base else "",
                              base[:-1] + "y" if base.endswith("i") else ""):
                if candidate in _POSITIVE:
                    return 1
                if candidate in _NEGATIVE:
                    return -1

    if word.endswith(("ridden", "infested")):
        return -1
    if word.endswith("worthy"):
        return 1
    return 0


def classify(sentence: str) -> str:
    text = sentence.lower().replace("’", "'")
    match = re.search(
        r"\b(?:was|were|is|are|be|seems?|looks?|feels?|tastes?)\s+"
        r"(.+?)(?=,\s*as\b|[.!?;]|$)",
        text,
    )
    clause = match.group(1) if match else text
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)*", clause)

    scores = [_polarity(word) for word in words]
    score = sum(scores)

    if re.search(r"\b(?:not|never|hardly|scarcely)\b|n't\b", clause):
        score = -score

    if score > 0:
        return "negative"
    if score < 0:
        return "positive"
    return "neutral"
